correctness.rationale: Exact factor trichotomy for a four-run word, the unique 10 central transition and letter requirements force all two-element solutions. Exhaustive conditional classification of those solutions (four families), reverse-complement symmetry, and explicit three-element witnesses prove the sharp 2/3 phase for every positive a,b,c,d; inclusion-exclusion gives exact pair counts. Package verifier independently matched every pair set for 1<=a,b,c,d<=6 (1296 quadruples, 125496 pairs), used a second literal checker on 2376 pairs, and checked 325 three-witness cases. The finite tests are corroboration, not the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: This is the simplest natural four-run binary word family whose optimal attractor can exceed the alphabet lower bound. Two explicitly sharp regions distinguish size three from two, and four exact endpoint families enumerate every size-two optimum for arbitrary run lengths. This gives a motivated structural subproblem of the larger recognized binary two-attractor classification, rather than a routine finite check or tiny table extension.
